name: wds_sun397
description: A webdataset variant of the SUN397 scene-recognition dataset, measuring performance on large-scale scene classification across 397 diverse categories. It is used to evaluate image classification models' scene understanding, robustness to intra-class variability, and generalization across many natural and man-made environments. Typically used for top-1/top-5 accuracy and robustness studies.
reputation: SUN397 is a well-known, widely cited scene classification benchmark; the webdataset variant is commonly used for large-scale training and evaluation pipelines.
